top_stories.title: Institutional Bitcoin Accumulation Continues
points: Bitcoin trading at $79,572, up 2.8% in 24 hours, approaching key $80,000 resistance level.
Bitcoin ETFs (exchange-traded funds that track Bitcoin's price without requiring direct ownership) reached $96.1 billion in total assets.
Strive purchased 1,110 Bitcoin in a major single transaction.
Ionic Digital added to its Bitcoin holdings, joining other public companies building reserves.
Microstrategy raised $2 billion via stock sales and created a dedicated USD cash reserve for potential future Bitcoin purchases, having paused direct buys since June.
Analysts describe the market as 'forming consensus around the bottom range' but warn a bull trap (a false signal suggesting a reversal upward before prices fall again) remains possible.
Rally supported by institutional bond buybacks, White House regulatory tailwinds (Clarity Act), and ETF inflows.

unique_angles.point: Frames corporate accumulation as removing coins from circulation and signaling Bitcoin's shift toward a standard institutional treasury asset class.
Ties price action directly to upcoming Fed policy signals and warns of possible bull trap despite bullish momentum.

items.title: Fed Policy Expectations and Jackson Hole Meeting
points: CME FedWatch tool shows 42% probability of a September 16 rate hike, while Myriad prediction market traders are more dovish at 33% for a 25 basis point increase (0.25% rate rise).
Kevin Warsh delivers his inaugural Jackson Hole keynote Friday as new Federal Reserve chair, seen as an early signal for the September rate decision.
Myriad data shows a sharp dovish repricing: hike probability fell from 34% to 26%, while 'No Change' odds strengthened to 69%.

items.title: AI-Driven Bitcoin Security Research
points: Developers are scanning Bitcoin's code for AI-discoverable security flaws as AI models give hackers unprecedented ability to find vulnerabilities.
A dedicated group is working to identify and patch these risks before they can be exploited.

issues.subject: Public Companies Are Still Stacking Bitcoin 💰

headlines: Strive purchased 1,110 Bitcoin, continuing the trend of major companies accumulating the asset as institutional adoption accelerates
Bitcoin ETFs (exchange-traded funds that track Bitcoin's price without requiring direct ownership) reached $96.1 billion in total assets, signaling sustained institutional investor interest
Ionic Digital added to its Bitcoin holdings, joining Strive and other public companies in building substantial cryptocurrency reserves

sections.title: Corporate Bitcoin Accumulation Momentum
points: Strive's 1,110 BTC purchase represents a significant single transaction by a major institution entering or expanding Bitcoin holdings
Ionic Digital's additional Bitcoin purchases demonstrate ongoing commitment from multiple public companies to build reserves
Bitcoin ETF growth to $96.1 billion shows institutional capital is flowing into regulated, accessible vehicles for Bitcoin exposure rather than direct asset custody

sections.title: What This Means for Bitcoin Markets
points: When public companies and large institutions accumulate Bitcoin, it removes coins from general circulation and can create upward pressure on price
ETF growth indicates Bitcoin is becoming a standard institutional asset class rather than a speculative or fringe investment
Continued corporate buying suggests confidence that regulatory clarity and market maturity make Bitcoin appropriate for treasury operations
